summary: Robust IRC is a distributed Internet Relay Chat server designed to operate without traditional network splits. It is written in Go and implements the custom RobustSession protocol to handle communication across distributed nodes.
goodFor: It suits administrators experimenting with alternative IRC network topologies and protocols that aim to prevent traditional netsplits.
watchOut: The project has a very low maintenance score and lacks tagged releases, indicating it may not be stable or actively supported for production environments.
deployNotes: As a Go binary, it typically runs as a standalone service, though you will likely need a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and persistent storage for any state it maintains.
